title: Potential spectral markers of intrinsic magnetic fields of hot exoplanets in the UV range
byline: Rumenskikh; Sharipov; S S; Shaikhislamov; I F; Ivanova; A E; Golubovsky; M P; Shcherbakov; K S; Taichenachev; A V; Maksimova; L A
html:
Abstract:A method for detecting the intrinsic magnetic fields of exoplanets, based on the effect of atomic alignment (the redistribution of populations among magnetic sublevels under the action of anisotropic radiation from the host star), has been adapted for observations with the Spektr-UV space telescope. A procedure for selecting sensitive transitions is proposed, and triplet absorption lines in the UV range that are sensitive to alignment are identified. On the basis of three-dimensional aeronomic models of the hot Jupiters KELT-20 b and HAT-P-32 b, absorption spectra in these lines are calculated for cases with and without intrinsic magnetic fields of the exoplanets. Using the Spektr-UV exposure-time calculator, the observability of the effect is assessed, and an observing program is proposed, specifying the optimal duration of individual exposures and the number of transits required to detect the signal.
